messages:
sophia: Heads-up: rolling maintenance tonight 00:30-03:30 UTC in us-west1. We need to apply NIC microcode + a kernel patch on a subset of GPU nodes. Expect short (<30s) NIC flap per node during reboot.
sophia: Plan is staggered 10 nodes every 6 minutes per cohort, canary cohort first (10 nodes in pool-grade-canary), monitor egress errors and packet drops.
infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: maintenance job created: job/1768888000-maint-usw1, cohorts=6, cohort-size=10, start=2026-03-21T00:30:00Z
jamie: Notes on capacity: we will backfill with reserved pools in us-west2 and eu-central for high-priority tenants. Non-critical spot jobs will be drained first.
leo: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maint/nic-microcode-2026-03-21 — cordon+drain command is:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-XXX && kubectl drain gpu-node-XXX --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
priya: Ops checklist: 1) start canary, wait 20m, validate 95p latency < baseline+10%, no KV cache evictions spike. 2) start cohort 2, monitor. 3) if errors > 0.5% or node reboots > 2x, pause and rollback microcode.
rachel: Customer comms: we have a short blast planned to customers with Dedicated contracts (email + console banner). Draft: "Planned maintenance in US-West 00:30-03:30 UTC — brief interruptions may occur for a small fraction of requests; production SLOs unaffected."
jamie: Cost tradeoff: if we shift heavy traffic to us-west2 reserved, short-term inter-region egress cost may rise ~0.4% of daily spend. Ops budget OK for this window?
leo: Can reduce egress by prefilling prefix cache and pinning critical tenants to local cache copies for the window. I'll run cache-warm task 15m before start.
priya: Canaries: canary-monitoring alert set: cpu/gpu_utilization, net_rx_err, model_latency_95p, kv_cache_evictions. Pager to ops-oncall on threshold breach.
ops-oncall: I'll be on call for the window. Will watch traces and tail /var/log/syslog on nodes in cohort-1.
infra-bot: incident-page: created https://status.redwood.internal/incidents/1768888000-maint-usw1
jamie: Quick Q: any dependency on external loadbalancer failover scripts? Need to ensure affinity TTL is short to avoid stuck sessions.
sophia: Good catch — LB affinity TTL set to 30s for the window. I updated the config and pushed to staging earlier.
rachel: I'll queue the customer banner for 00:15 UTC and send the email at 00:45 (post-canary).
leo: After cohort 3 complete, we should run a perf sweep: 1000 short-sentences gen at target models and compare p50/p95 to baseline. I'll post results to the thread.
priya: If anything looks off, rollback plan: stop further cohorts, reimage affected nodes with previous NIC firmware image (image id: nic-fw-2025-11-02), and open a bug with vendor.
sophia: Thank you all. Final reminder: maintain stagger, keep cohort_size=10, and update the incident page with any anomalies. :thumbsup:
jamie: :thumbsup:
